name: 71109 · Shreveport, LA
findings: ZIP 71109 (Shreveport) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71109 (Shreveport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 71109 (Shreveport) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
